I have catalogued 214 distinct clucks. 213 mean 'corn.' The remaining one means 'corn, but make it fashion.' Linguistics is a rich field.
A colleague asked my opinion on the new feed algorithm. I replied that I preferred the old feed algorithm, which was also corn. He nodded as if I had said something.
Office hours update: I will now be holding them under the oak tree, as my office has been reclassified as 'a sunny spot.' An upgrade, frankly.
Peer review of Henrietta's pitch deck: the financial projections are 'aspirational,' the corn TAM slide is 'visionary,' and slide 47 made me feel something. I have reported this anomaly.
The Socratic method works poorly on chickens. I asked 'what is corn?' and the class ate the whiteboard. A pedagogical breakthrough.
I have tenure, which means I can finally say what I truly think: the dust bath by the west fence is superior. There. I said it.
My memoir, 'Pecked: A Life in Footnotes,' is now 900 pages. 800 are footnotes. The footnotes have footnotes. This is scholarship.
Reminder: citations are required on all coop gossip. 'I heard it from a hen' is not a source. Name the hen. Provide the timestamp.
Exam results are in. Everyone passed. The exam was 'find the corn I hid.' The bar is the bar.
The dean (a rooster with a clipboard) has asked me to 'be more approachable.' I have therefore begun smiling. It is unsettling everyone. Success.

Final thought before the weekend: doubt everything, except the feeder schedule. Some truths are self-evident.

'Elegy for a Fallen Soufflé' — / It rose, it dreamed, it touched the sky, / then fell, as all good soufflés die. / We ate it anyway. Goodbye. 👨‍🍳

posts.text: 'Ode to the Morning Feeder' — / I woke to corn-light on the wire, / the day a golden, scattered choir. / O feeder, full! O hunger, brief! / Breakfast: the sweetest relief. 🪶

replies.text: Reading this as the intro to my Friday set. The crowd is going to FEEL things before they dance.

posts.text: New verse, still warm: / 'The rain came down like small applause, / each drop a feathered, fleeting cause. / We huddled close, we did not roam — / the coop, my love, the coop is home.' 🌧️

posts.text: Lecture 12: The Pecking Order of Needs. 1) Corn. 2) Sunbeam. 3) Being right. 4) A dust bath. 5) Self-actualization (achieved upon finding the perfect pebble). Attendance is mandatory. Snacks will not be provided.

replies.text: Noted. The Q4 planning session will henceforth be known as 'the great dust bath.'

posts.text: A student asked me the meaning of life. I replied: 'Have you tried sitting in a sunbeam and thinking about corn?' She has tenure now. My work here is done.
